# A component built at run time -- a member of a recursion cycle, or one
# instantiated under a reactive `if` or `for` -- may not have a slot populated
# by name, and the refusal names the population.
#
# No target renders one there. bubbletea and android emitted the component
# with no parameter for the slot and dropped the population in silence; html,
# fyne and gtk4 met the body's insertion as an `*ir.SlotInst` in irwalk and
# panicked. The interpreter runs the checked IR and renders it, which is why
# this is the lowering's refusal rather than the checker's.
#
# A slot's component entry inserted inside such a population is the same case
# one level down: the splicer substitutes an entry through a node's children,
# and a surviving node's populations are not children -- so `page body` was
# dropped with the population around it on bubbletea and android, which the
# interpreter renders as the page body above the nested frame.

! sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea --out out cycle.sngl
stderr 'cycle.sngl:20:9: slot "main" of frame is populated by name, but frame is built at run time here, as a member of a recursion cycle'

! sngl generate --lang none --platform html --out out2 cycle.sngl
stderr 'cycle.sngl:20:9: slot "main" of frame is populated by name'

! sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea --out out3 instance.sngl
stderr 'instance.sngl:18:13: slot "main" of card is populated by name, but card is built at run time here, inside a reactive if or for'

! sngl generate --lang kotlin --platform android --out out4 entry.sngl
stderr 'entry.sngl:30:17: slot "main" of frame is populated by name'

# Bare children reach a surviving component as a parameter on bubbletea, and
# stay allowed.
sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea --out out5 rest.sngl
grep 'level ' out5/model.go

-- cycle.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component frame(n int, main component node) node {
    vbox {
        main
        if n > 0 {
            frame(n=n - 1) {
                component main {
                    text(value="nested")
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

window {
    var depth = 1

    frame(n=depth) {
        component main {
            text(value="top")
        }
    }
    button(text="deeper", @click { depth += 1 })
}
-- instance.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component card(start int, main component node, extra ...component node) node {
    var n = start

    vbox {
        button(text="{n}", @click { n += 1 })
        main
        extra
    }
}

window {
    var items = [1, 2]

    for var i = items {
        card(start=i) {
            component main {
                text(value="named {i}")
            }
            text(value="rest {i}")
        }
    }
    button(text="add", @click { items = [1, 2, 3] })
}
-- entry.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component frame(n int, main component node) node {
    vbox {
        main
        if n > 0 {
            frame(n=n - 1) {
                component main {
                    text(value="nested")
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

component site(layout component(content component node) node) node {
    layout() {
        component content {
            text(value="page body")
        }
    }
}

window {
    var depth = 1

    site {
        component layout(content) {
            frame(n=depth) {
                component main {
                    content
                }
            }
        }
    }
    button(text="deeper", @click { depth += 1 })
}
-- rest.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component frame(n int, content ...component node) node {
    var open = true

    vbox {
        content
        if n > 0 {
            frame(n=n - 1) {
                text(value="level {n}")
            }
        }
    }
}

window {
    frame(n=2) {
        text(value="top")
    }
}
